issues.description: The script injects a large amount of UI via innerHTML, but all content is static and not based on user input or URL parameters. No DOM XSS found.
issues.recommendation: If dynamic content is ever added, sanitize all user input before inserting into the DOM.

issues.description: The script requests no special permissions (@grant none) and does not use any network APIs (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, GM_xmlhttpRequest, WebSocket, etc.).

summary: The script does not perform any network requests, does not collect or transmit user data, and does not use any dangerous or obfuscated code. All UI is statically defined and does not use user input, so DOM XSS risk is minimal. No supply chain or permission risks detected. Overall, the script is safe for use.
